outcome: Severity of APIP (mild acute pancreatitis, severe acute pancreatitis)
cohort: The study participants were 52 pregnant women diagnosed with acute pancreatitis treated at 5 tertiary care centers.
finding: Hypertriglyceridemia was found to be the most common cause of acute pancreatitis in pregnancy, and the initial heart rate upon admission showed the highest ability to predict severe acute pancreatitis, which was associated with a higher risk of neonatal asphyxia.
